Serve.

description: Prepared with liver, bacon, and onion.

ingredients.name: a handful of bread crusts, grated

When cooked, remove the bacon layer and turn it a few more times until the roast has taken on a good color.
Serve with some compote.

steps: Dig a hole in the earth deep enough to contain the piece of meat to be cooked.
